rendererScope: This episode only; future episodes require their own scene and shot design.

scenes.name: Julius Caesar
scenes.title: A name is not an answer
scenes.question: Does victory leave a republic, or personal power?
scenes.action: The fingers press into the table, then stop. Andre lets the question land before answering.
scenes.light: Warm, diffuse oil-lamp direction; steady exposure on skin. Ochre plaster and muted red.
scenes.sound: Small flame, distant room tone, a dry sleeve against the grain. No cheering crowd.
scenes.costume: Muted wool and linen; an understated drape. Fabric weight and fold direction carry status.
scenes.warning: Fictional room and casting. Review the costume as a concept; no portrait, bust or polished vessel may reveal a face.

scenes.name: Genghis Khan
scenes.title: What an empire carries
scenes.question: Can connection and destruction belong to the same legacy?
scenes.action: One grip loosens. Andre stays upright and keeps a level, humane gaze.
scenes.light: Felt-filtered amber and soft fire bounce. No moving flame shadow across eyes.
scenes.sound: Wind in felt, restrained leather creak, low fire. Avoid battle spectacle.
scenes.costume: Current candidate: blue patterned fabric, leather belt and ring. Proposed direction: restrained campaign clothing; confirm material and period details.
scenes.warning: The eye pair differs in brow colour and texture. The blue costume is a candidate, not a locked campaign outfit. No later imperial palace.

scenes.name: Galileo Galilei
scenes.title: A question survives
scenes.question: Does silencing a person settle a question?
scenes.action: A hand rests beside a blank page. Andre leans forward only a fraction, then becomes still.
scenes.light: Soft cool window light, warm wood retained; page readable, face never overexposed.
scenes.sound: Quiet air, a single paper movement, a faint chair creak. Let stillness carry the final beat.
scenes.costume: Dark, plain scholar layers; soft aged cloth. No theatrical wizard robe.
scenes.warning: The costume reference contains generated writing; replace it with a reviewed prop before a readable close-up. Do not depict later blindness or insert a legendary quotation.

scenes.name: Napoleon Bonaparte
scenes.title: The price of greatness
scenes.question: Can greatness be separated from its price?
scenes.action: A hand stops above a closed book. Andre does not lean away from the second question.
scenes.light: Muted sea-grey window light and damp plaster. Preserve skin warmth without a sepia wash.
scenes.sound: Distant wind, restrained room creak, cloth. Sea stays outside the scene.
scenes.costume: Dark green wool concept, pale waistcoat and shirt, restrained brass. Verify tailoring and remove unmotivated rings in future design.
scenes.warning: The current costume candidate has several rings; do not copy them into continuity without review. No claim of exact Longwood reconstruction.

scenes.name: J. Robert Oppenheimer
scenes.title: What comes next
scenes.question: Can technical success answer a moral question?
scenes.action: A resting hand loses its tension. Andre stops speaking and stays present for the silence.
scenes.light: Dusty pre-dawn blue and one muted practical lamp. No flash, mushroom cloud or reflected face.
scenes.sound: Sparse desert wind and room tone. No dramatic detonation under the city names.
scenes.costume: Plain pale shirt, muted civilian jacket and fabric creases. Avoid borrowing a movie actor’s styling.
scenes.warning: The eye pair changes brow darkness and gaze. The meeting is fictional. No weapons diagrams, unsupported casualty totals or claimed quotation from the test.
